source_context: \caption{Regional RMS zero-mean-prior affine posterior-mean shift divided by trained-prediction RMS error, with both quantities evaluated on the same full-time region. Entries give across-run ranges ($8$ Burgers--MLP runs and $3$ in each other family). Baseline is $(\alpha_0,1)$; MLE is $(\alpha_0,\widehat v)$.
